title: Small Group E-Bike Tour the Banff Local Explorer
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Ample free customer parking is available at the Banff Train Station
Not recommended for those who are not confident riding a bicycle.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
On this leisurely 2 to 2 hours and 30 minutes leisurely e-bike tour you will explore the best spots in and around Banff, cruising between epic views. 

First your qualified guide will take you to the Vermilion Lakes to look back at the iconic Mt Rundle where photographers often gather to capture one Canada's classic mountain reflection shots. 

Crossing through town, and the Bow River, next stop is the cascading Bow Falls, and around the beautiful Banff Springs Golf Course. More than just a stunning course, the links are a favorite grazing spot for wildlife including elk, deer and even bears on occasion! 

Multiple stopping points along the route, where you can soak up the stunning scenery, your guide will share with you history of the area, and geological facts and figures that are often overlooked.
